title: Analysis of the long-term behavior of the "Bando--follow-the-leader'' car-following model
summary: In this article, we investigate the long-term behavior of the ``Bando--follow-the-leader'' car-following model, whose well-posedness and stability with respect to delay were analyzed in a recent work \cite{gong2023well}. We first establish the collision-free property of the model with \(N+1\in\N_{\geq2}\) vehicles over an infinite time horizon, assuming that the trajectory of the first vehicle is prescribed, by demonstrating the existence of a uniform strictly positive lower bound on the space headway between adjacent vehicles.
